case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 8167 OF 2023); CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 8188 OF 2023)
summary: Bail plea by former Delhi Deputy CM in corruption and money laundering cases; alleged misuse of discretion in excise policy formulation; constitutional validity of Articles 74 and 163 protections challenged; scope of PML Act provisions debated; reliance on witness statements retracted or deemed coerced; money trail unsubstantiated; cabinet decision-making process scrutinized; bail denied due to gravity of charges and flight risk.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.7A, s.8, s.12
Indian Penal Code s.120B, s.201, s.420
Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3, s.4, s.45, s.50
Constitution of India Art.74, Art.163, Art.20
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.164, s.50
Vijay Madanlal Choudhary v. Union of India
final_judgment: Bail denied; custody extended; trial to proceed without interference; allegations of procedural impropriety and coerced testimonies dismissed as insufficient grounds for bail.
